description: Every site the caller's connected Bing Webmaster OAuth grant can access — the data source for picking which site to bind to a project (see set_bing_site). Live call to the Bing Webmaster API (GetUserSites) under the caller's OWN OAuth token, not the operator key. Read-only and FREE (no credits). Check `requiresReconnect` before treating an empty `sites` list as 'no sites': true means the stored grant can no longer reach Bing Webmaster.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_bing_sites
